aerobic_base.description: Aerobic threshold development, ADS diagnosis and cure, fat adaptation, volume guidelines, continuous training methods, base building principles

intensity_zones.description: Five-zone training system, AeT and LT testing methods, Ten Percent Test, polarized training, zone definitions and training effects

periodization.description: Training phases (transition, base, precompetition, competition), capacity vs utilization, load progression, taper protocols, race planning, athlete categories

strength_training.description: General and specific strength, assessment protocols, strength programs (stages 1-3), hill sprints, muscular endurance (gym and outdoor), core training

recovery.description: Recovery methods ranked by importance, fatigue types and management, monitoring tools, returning after illness/breaks, overtraining syndrome, ferritin

mental_toughness.description: Central governor theory, race psychology strategies, reframing adversity, managing lows in ultras, mantras, faking positivity, seven key race recommendations

weekly_structure.description: Week type templates (Base, Intensity, Recovery, Specificity, Taper, Goal), example training weeks, modulation patterns, race season management

nutrition_racing.description: Pre-run fueling, during-run calories by distance, post-run recovery window, hydration and electrolytes, hyponatremia prevention, daily nutrition principles, iron for runners

nutrition_daily.description: Plant-based eating for endurance athletes, protein strategies, example daily diet, race-day recipes (rice balls, quinoa porridge), transitioning to plant-based, iron for vegetarians
